items.title: Smulyan interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: his brother would have Sun Ra, he’d have Albert Ayler and Charles Tyler, and all these complete Free music going on.

ctx.x: John Gilmore, thank you. Albert Ayler. Did those people have any impact on you? © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -13-

I was listening to them when I was younger. I had a childhood friend named Peter Schmidt who’s father was the original French horn player in the New York Brass Quintet and I went to high school with him. And his brother Fred was a big avante garde jazz fan. And so when I would go over to his house and hang out and play and talk and I mean just whatever kids do, his brother would have Sun Ra, he’d have Albert Ayler and Charles Tyler, and all these complete Free music going on. So I was exposed to that when I was…
